Overview

Chuncheon is a city in GWN with a population of 285,000. The capital of Gangwon Province, a scenic lakeside city known for dakgalbi, the Soyang River Dam, and nearby ski resorts. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
